name: Exp_Fractal_WeightOscillator
summary: This EA trades based on a Fractal Weighted Oscillator that combines fractal dimension analysis with weighted price momentum to identify trend strength and direction. It generates buy/sell signals when the oscillator crosses dynamic threshold levels derived from fractal geometry. The system opens positions systematically when momentum shifts are confirmed by fractal structure changes.
summary_zh: 该EA基于分形加权振荡器进行交易，结合分形维度分析与加权价格动量来识别趋势强度和方向。当振荡器穿越由分形几何推导的动态阈值水平时，产生买入/卖出信号。系统在动量转变被分形结构变化确认时系统性开仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于分形加权振荡器，利用市场的分形结构特征来衡量价格运动的自相似性和复杂度。入场条件为振荡器值穿越零轴或动态阈值线，向上穿越时做多，向下穿越时做空，这代表动量方向发生了分形确认的转变。出场条件依赖于振荡器反向穿越信号或固定止损止盈设置，部分版本可能包含移动止损逻辑。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户权益百分比的动态手数计算方式，但具体实现取决于参数配置。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损参数来控制单笔风险，但未观察到基于波动率（如ATR）的自适应止损机制。整体策略属于动量类方法，试图捕捉分形结构变化所预示的趋势启动阶段，适合在趋势明显的历史周期中运行。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on a Fractal Weighted Oscillator, which leverages the fractal structure characteristics of the market to measure self-similarity and complexity of price movements. Entry conditions are triggered when the oscillator value crosses the zero line or a dynamic threshold level — an upward crossover generates a buy signal while a downward crossover generates a sell signal, representing a momentum direction shift confirmed by fractal structure changes. Exit conditions rely on the oscillator's reverse crossover signal or fixed stop-loss and take-profit settings, with some implementations potentially including trailing stop logic. Position sizing employs either fixed lot sizes or dynamic lot calculation based on account equity percentage, though the specific implementation depends on parameter configuration. In terms of money management, the EA provides stop-loss parameters to control per-trade risk, but no volatility-based (e.g., ATR) adaptive stop mechanism was observed. The overall strategy falls into the momentum category, attempting to capture trend initiation phases signaled by fractal structure changes, and is best suited for periods with clear trending behavior.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points; close on cumulative profit

parameters.name: OscThreshold
parameters.description: 振荡器阈值，0表示零轴交叉

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 移动止损点数，0表示禁用

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术号，用于识别本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: Magic number; 0 to manage all orders

parameters.name: TimeFrame
parameters.description: 交易时间周期，0为当前图表周期

pros: 分形维度分析提供了非传统视角的市场结构识别，与传统技术指标形成互补
加权振荡器设计能够平滑噪声信号，减少虚假突破导致的频繁交易
振荡器穿越信号逻辑清晰，入场规则明确无歧义，便于回测验证
支持多时间周期分析，可以在不同尺度上确认分形结构变化
pros_en: Fractal dimension analysis provides a non-traditional perspective on market structure identification, complementing conventional technical indicators
The weighted oscillator design smooths noisy signals and reduces frequent trades caused by false breakouts
Oscillator crossover signal logic is clear and unambiguous, with well-defined entry rules suitable for backtesting verification
Supports multi-timeframe analysis, enabling fractal structure change confirmation across different scales
cons: 分形维度计算对参数敏感，不同周期设置可能导致截然不同的交易结果
默认止损止盈为0，若用户未手动设置则面临无限亏损风险
缺乏市场状态过滤机制（如波动率过滤、趋势强度过滤），在震荡市中可能频繁止损
未观察到仓位规模与波动率挂钩的动态调整机制，固定手数在高波动时风险偏大
分形指标在低流动性或跳空行情中可能产生错误信号
cons_en: Fractal dimension calculation is sensitive to parameters, and different period settings can lead to drastically different trading results
Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, exposing the user to unlimited loss risk if not manually configured
Lacks market regime filtering mechanisms (e.g., volatility filter, trend strength filter), which may cause frequent stop-outs in ranging markets
No dynamic position sizing linked to volatility was observed; fixed lots carry higher risk during high-volatility periods
Fractal indicators may produce false signals during low-liquidity conditions or gap events
improvements: 增加基于ATR的自适应止损止盈机制，使风险控制随市场波动率动态调整
添加市场状态识别模块（如ADX趋势强度过滤），仅在趋势明确时交易，震荡市中暂停开仓
引入仓位比例风险模型，根据止损距离和账户风险百分比自动计算手数
增加分形周期自适应优化逻辑，根据近期市场特征自动调整计算参数
improvements_en: Add ATR-based adaptive stop-loss and take-profit mechanism so risk control dynamically adjusts with market volatility
Add a market regime identification module (e.g., ADX trend strength filter) to trade only when trends are clear and pause entries in ranging markets
Introduce a proportional risk position sizing model that automatically calculates lot size based on stop distance and account risk percentage
Implement adaptive fractal period optimization logic that automatically adjusts calculation parameters based on recent market characteristics

risk_points: 默认止损止盈为零，用户不设置则无风险底线保护
固定手数仓位管理未与波动率或账户风险百分比挂钩
分形振荡器在震荡行情中可能产生连续虚假信号导致多次止损
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一K线内重复开仓
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, leaving no risk floor protection if the user does not configure them
Fixed lot position sizing is not linked to volatility or account risk percentage
Fractal oscillator may generate consecutive false signals in ranging markets, leading to multiple stop-outs
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially allowing repeated position openings within the same bar
